title: Pokemon TCG Mimikyu Paldean Fates 037/091 Holo Card
categoryName: Toys & Hobbies:Collectible Card Games:CCG Individual Cards
descriptionText: This rare Mimikyu card from the Pokémon TCG features the psychic type and has a holographic finish. It is part of the Scarlet & Violet: Paldean Fates set and has the card number 037/091. The card is a basic stage Pokémon with 70 HP and is perfect for collectors or players of the game.
